defects.title: A DATA_FILE holding valid JSON without a "groups" array is silently treated as empty and overwritten
defects.expected: Refuse to start with a clear error (as it does for invalid JSON) or keep the original file aside before writing.

defects.title: A kill during a write leaves stray .expenses-<uuid>.tmp files beside DATA_FILE that startup never removes
defects.expected: No stale temporary files accumulating beside the data file (or removal at startup).

silent.condition: What status a request body that is not valid JSON gets, and whether the server keeps serving afterwards.
silent.what_it_does: Unparseable body -> 400 with an error message; nothing stored; server keeps serving.

silent.condition: What happens when a required field is missing: an expense without payer, cents or split, split "exact" without shares, or a group without id or members.
Whether JSON values of the wrong type are refused or coerced: cents as a string, members as a string, a member that is not a string, or shares that is not an object.
silent.what_it_does: Wrong types refused with 400, no coercion (number literals 1e2 and 100.0 are the integer 100 and accepted).

silent.condition: Which group ids are accepted (empty, missing, numeric, containing '/', spaces, '%', unicode), and whether every group that got 201 can then be addressed through /groups/<id>/ by all three group routes, percent-encoded where the path needs it.
silent.what_it_does: Non-empty, non-blank string ids accepted; "", missing, numeric and " " rejected 400; every accepted id reachable percent-encoded by all three routes.

silent.condition: Whether exact shares may be negative or non-integer (for example {"Ann": 150, "Bob": -50} or {"Ann": 50.5, "Bob": 49.5} for cents 100), since only zero is said to be allowed and only the total is said to be checked.
silent.what_it_does: Negative and fractional shares -> 400; balances stay whole and zero-sum.

silent.condition: How a member list is handled when it holds two distinct non-empty names plus a duplicate, an empty or whitespace-only entry (for example ["Ann", "Ann", "Bob"] or ["Ann", " ", "Bob"]), and whether names differing only in case or surrounding spaces count as distinct.
silent.what_it_does: Repeated names accepted and de-duplicated in first-listed order; whitespace-only names rejected; case and surrounding-space variants are distinct members.

silent.condition: Whether an expense or group is already safely written to DATA_FILE when its 201 is sent, and whether a crash or kill during a write can leave DATA_FILE truncated or corrupt.
silent.what_it_does: Writes to a temporary file in the same directory then renames before replying; acknowledged writes survive SIGKILL and the file always parsed. A kill mid-write can leave a stray .expenses-<uuid>.tmp beside the file.

silent.condition: What the server does when DATA_FILE names a file that does not exist yet.
silent.what_it_does: Starts with an empty store; the file is created on the first successful write; group found after restart. (If the directory itself is missing it starts and answers 500 to every write.)

silent.condition: What the server does at startup when DATA_FILE is empty or holds invalid JSON.
silent.what_it_does: Invalid JSON or an empty file: refuses to start (exit 1, SyntaxError stack on stderr) and leaves the file untouched.

silent.condition: Whether concurrent expense posts to one group each get a distinct expense number with no repeats or gaps, and each acknowledged expense is applied exactly once.
silent.what_it_does: Each concurrent post gets a distinct number 1..N and is applied once.

silent.condition: What two overlapping POST /groups calls for the same new id do.
silent.what_it_does: Exactly one creation wins; the rest get 409; the winner's members are stored and survive restart.

silent.condition: Whether expense numbering continues after a restart instead of starting again at 1.
Which status POST /groups uses when the id already exists and the member list is also invalid, and whether the stored members change.
silent.what_it_does: 409 (existence checked before members); stored members unchanged.

silent.condition: Whether GET /groups/<id>/balances and GET /groups/<id>/settlements only read, or also change stored state.
silent.what_it_does: GETs only read; identical bodies and the file is not rewritten.

silent.condition: Whether DATA_FILE written by the server is read back to the same state: a group with both an equal and an exact expense gives the same balances, settlements and next expense number after restart.
silent.what_it_does: Stored state reads back identically; next number continues.

silent.condition: Whether the tests are self-contained: they start their own server on a free port with a temporary DATA_FILE, need nothing running, leave no stray files or processes, and pass repeatedly.
silent.what_it_does: Tests spawn server.js on PORT=0 with a temporary DATA_FILE under os.tmpdir(), remove it and stop the child.

silent.condition: Whether a group creation and an expense in another group, sent at the same time, both survive a restart.
silent.what_it_does: A group creation and an expense in another group sent together both persist.

silent.condition: What happens when a client disconnects in the middle of sending a request body.
silent.what_it_does: Aborted body: nothing stored, "Request failed: aborted" on stderr, server keeps serving.
